I, Gayantha Karunatilake, Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are neededfor a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

The allotments of land depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Mu/MLL/2017/113 and dated 27.11.2017, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Village called Kumarapuram in the DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Maritimepattu in Mullaitive District,Northern Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Puliyadiyil Kadu – Extent: About 0.5371 HectareNorth: Road (RDA) and Puliyadiyil Kadu claimed byThamotharampillai Nadarasapillai and others; East: Puliyadiyil Kaduclaimed by Thamotharampillai Nadarasapillai and others andTP 226583; South: TP 226583 and Lot B; West: Lot B andRoad (RDA).
02. Lot ‘B’ – Puliyadiyil Kadu – Extent: About 1.9469 HectaresNorth: Road (RDA) and Lot A; East: Lot A and TP 226583;South: TP 226583 and Lot C; West: Lot C and Road (RDA).
03. Lot ‘C’ – Puliyadiyil Kadu – Extent: About 2.5645 HectaresNorth: Road (RDA) and Lot B; East: Lot B and TP 226583;South: TP 226583 and Lot D; West: Lot D and Road (RDA).

04. Lot ‘D’ – Puliyadiyil Kadu – Extent: About 2.4453 HectaresNorth: Road (RDA) and Lot C; East: Lot C and TP 226583;South: TP 226583 and Puliyadiyil Kadu claimed by KumaraiyahaVijayakumary; West: Puliyadiyil Kadu claimed by KumaraiyahaVijayakumary and Road (RDA).
Gayantha Karunatilake,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
